question:
In a given triangle ABC, DE parallel BC {and} (AD)/(DB)=(3)/(5). If AC = 5.6 cm, then find AE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43ec14cd6747ca4aaddc30014180a8abab237b3531d628edeb718a0d3add91d2.png]
solution:
**Given:**

In triangle ABC, DE∥BC

AD/DB = 3/5 and AC = 5.6 cm 

**Concept used:**

Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT) = If line DE is parallel to side BC of triangle ABC that intersects the other sides into two points, line DE divides sides AB and AC in proportion.

AD/AB = AE/AC

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43ec14cd6747ca4aaddc30014180a8abab237b3531d628edeb718a0d3add91d2.png] 

In triangle ABC, AD/DB = 3/5

⇒ AD/AB = AE/AC = 3/(3 + 5) = 3/8 

⇒ AE/5.6 cm = 3/8 

⇒ AE = 5.6 × 3/8 

**∴ AE = 2.1 cm **
